ai_summary: Galaxy Surfactants Limited has announced the board-approved appointment of Mr. Uday K. Kamat as an Additional Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director, effective October 5, 2026, pending shareholder approval. Mr. Kamat brings over 43 years of extensive experience in finance and management, which is a key takeaway and could significantly strengthen the board. No red flags were identified, with the company noting he has not been debarred by any authority, though his non-independent status means he will not provide purely independent oversight.
